everyone.summary: 97.8 million more adults vote. New Mexico flips, but Bush still wins, 281–256–1. The closest call is Nevada, which holds for Bush by 0.1 points. Kerry wins in 16 of 100 draws.
assumptions: Every adult votes. Non-citizens choose like naturalized citizens of their state and sex; Black Southerners like Black voters outside the South; everyone else as their group did in 2004.
howIGotThis: What changed: Every adult can vote, and turns out.
New voters borrow the behaviour of naturalized citizens of the same state and sex; Black voters outside the South.
The numbers: the 2000 and 2010 census counts interpolated to 2004 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 2004 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.
